mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, start_date, end_date, category, status, all_day, created_at, updated_at FROM schedule
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (title, description, start_date, end_date, category, status, all_day) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{category}, #{status}, #{allDay})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, category = #{category}, status = #{status}, all_day = #{allDay} WHERE id = #{id}
